title: Muti-target rationale design of novel substituted N-phenyl-2-((6-phenylpyridazin-3-yl)thio)acetamide candidates as telomerase/JAK1/STAT3/TLR4 inhibitors: In vitro and in vivo investigations.
authors: Shaldam, Moataz A; Mousa, Mai H A; Tawfik, Haytham O; El-Dessouki, Ahmed M; Sharaky, Marwa; Saleh, Mohamed M; Alzahrani, Abdullah Yahya Abdullah; Moussa, Sana Ben; Al-Karmalawy, Ahmed A
one_liner_zh: 该文设计并合成靶向端粒酶/JAK1/STAT3/TLR4的多靶点抗肿瘤小分子抑制剂，虽含分子对接但对象为蛋白-小分子，非蛋白质-DNA互作，且无AI或物理模拟方法，与本课题关联微弱。
abstract: In this work, additional effort was applied to design new BIBR1532-based analogues with potential inhibitory activity against telomerase and acting as multitarget antitumor candidates to overcome the resistance problem. Therefore, novel substituted N-phenyl-2-((6-phenylpyridazin-3-yl)thio)acetamide candidates (4a-n) were synthesized. Applying the lead optimization strategy of the previously designed compound 8e; compound 4l showed an improved telomerase inhibition of 64.95 % and a superior growth inhibition of 79 % suggesting its potential use as a successful "multitarget-directed drug" for cancer therapy. Accordingly, compound 4l was further selected to evaluate its additional JAK1/STAT3/TLR4 inhibitory potentials. Compound 4l represented a very promising JAK1 inhibitory potential with a 0.46-fold change, compared to that of pacritinib reference standard (0.33-fold change). Besides, it showed a superior STAT3-inhibitory potential with a 0.22-fold change compared to sorafenib (0.33-fold change). Additionally, compound 4l downregulated TLR4 protein expression by 0.81-fold change compared to that of resatorvid (0.29-fold change). Also, molecular docking was performed to investigate the binding mode and affinity of the superior candidate 4l towards the four target receptors (telomerase, JAK1, STAT3, and TLR4). Furthermore, the therapeutic potential of compound 4l as an antitumor agent was additionally explored through in vivo studies involving female mice implanted with Solid Ehrlich Carcinoma (SEC). Remarkably, compound 4l led to prominent reductions in tumor size and mass. Concurrent enhancements in biochemical, hematologic, histopathologic, and immunohistochemical parameters further confirmed the suppression of angiogenesis and inflammation, elucidating additional mechanisms by which compound 4l exerts its anticancer effects.
abstract_zh: 在本研究中，我们投入了额外努力，设计基于BIBR1532的新型类似物，旨在对端粒酶具有潜在抑制活性，并作为多靶点抗肿瘤候选药物以克服耐药性问题。因此，合成了一系列新型取代的N-苯基-2-((6-苯基哒嗪-3-基)硫代)乙酰胺候选化合物（4a-n）。应用先前设计的化合物8e的先导优化策略，化合物4l显示出改善的端粒酶抑制活性（64.95%）和优越的生长抑制率（79%），表明其作为癌症治疗中成功的“多靶点导向药物”的潜在应用价值。据此，进一步选择化合物4l评估其额外的JAK1/STAT3/TLR4抑制潜力。化合物4l表现出非常有前景的JAK1抑制潜力，其0.46倍变化，与帕克替尼参考标准（0.33倍变化）相比。此外，与索拉非尼（0.33倍变化）相比，它显示出优越的STAT3抑制潜力，其0.22倍变化。另外，化合物4l下调TLR4蛋白表达，其0.81倍变化，与瑞沙托维（0.29倍变化）相比。同时，进行了分子对接研究，以探究优越候选化合物4l对四个靶受体（端粒酶、JAK1、STAT3和TLR4）的结合模式和亲和力。此外，通过涉及植入实体艾氏癌（SEC）的雌性小鼠的体内研究，进一步探索了化合物4l作为抗肿瘤剂的治疗潜力。值得注意的是，化合物4l导致肿瘤大小和质量显著减小。同时，生化、血液学、组织病理学和免疫组织化学参数的改善进一步证实了血管生成和炎症的抑制，阐明了化合物4l发挥其抗癌作用的额外机制。
